# The Pensieve OSINT

> An analyst second brain for Open-Source Intelligence: curated tools, public sources, investigation playbooks, analyst-memory patterns, intelligence taxonomy, Brazil/LATAM resources and a machine-readable knowledge graph.

The canonical repository is https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT. The project separates observations from inferences and treats tool results as leads/evidence that require appropriate corroboration.

## Primary entry points

- [Repository README](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/README.md): human-oriented project overview
- [Second Brain Architecture](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/docs/SECOND-BRAIN.md): memory and retrieval model
- [OSINT Arsenal](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/docs/ARSENAL.md): curated resources by investigative function
- [Investigation Router](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/docs/ROUTER.md): input-first routing model
- [Analyst Workflow](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/docs/WORKFLOW.md): scope to report methodology
- [AI Discovery Guide](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/docs/AI-DISCOVERY.md): machine-consumption rules
- [Knowledge Graph](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/docs/KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH.md): node and edge model
- [Intelligence Taxonomy](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/docs/INTELLIGENCE-TAXONOMY.md): OSINT/SOCMINT/GEOINT/IMINT/CTI and related disciplines
- [Brazil & LATAM](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/docs/BRAZIL-LATAM.md): regional public-source pack

## Machine-readable knowledge

- [Tools JSON](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/knowledge/tools.json): canonical tool/source records
- [Inputs JSON](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/knowledge/inputs.json): normalized input types
- [Outputs JSON](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/knowledge/outputs.json): output semantics and non-equivalences
- [Sources JSON](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/knowledge/sources.json): selected source cards
- [Playbooks JSON](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/knowledge/playbooks.json): investigation plans
- [Projects JSON](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/knowledge/projects.json): Ridd1kulusC0d3r OSINT ecosystem
- [INT Taxonomy JSON](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/knowledge/int-taxonomy.json): machine-readable taxonomy
- [Relations JSON](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/knowledge/relations.json): curated semantic edges
- [Tool JSON Schema](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/knowledge/schema.json): record contract
- [AI Index](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/The-Pensieve-OSINT/blob/main/ai-index.json): repository manifest

## Analyst memory

## Specialist projects

- [Mineiro Username Intelligence](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/Mineiro-OSINT-Extractor): username/public-presence workbench
- [T.O.C.A.I.A](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/tocaia-osint): behavioral OSINT and meaningful-absence methodology
- [OSINT Checklist](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/osintchecklist): workflow and investigation logbook
- [F.I.O. Lab](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/FIO): Brazilian public-data and identifier analysis
- [Tropeiro Intel](https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/tropeiro-intel): defensive OSINT / cyber threat intelligence

## Usage constraints

Use lawful public or authorized information. Preserve provenance. Do not treat username matches, shared infrastructure, visual similarity, reputation labels, graph edges or absence as automatic identity/attribution proof. Public repository content must not contain sensitive case data.
